themes.description: Users repeatedly report that Fixed Deposit (FD) transactions are not credited correctly or promptly, with delayed or missing payouts, incorrect maturity amounts, and refusal to refund money when bookings fail.
themes.business_impact: Loss of user trust and retention, increased churn as users delete the app, and potential regulatory scrutiny due to financial mis‑management.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inadequate integration with banking APIs leading to failed or delayed fund transfers, coupled with insufficient error handling and lack of clear communication protocols for refunds.
themes.action_plan:
• Revamp FD transaction flow to include real‑time payment confirmation
• Implement a robust reconciliation system with bank statements
• Add clear escalation paths for failed withdrawals
• Provide real‑time status updates in the app
• Conduct end‑to‑end testing of FD booking and refund scenarios
• Deploy monitoring dashboards to flag anomalies
• Train customer support on FD processes
• Review fee/penalty disclosures for transparency

themes.description: Users consistently report that customer care is unresponsive, with many stating they never receive a reply via email, WhatsApp, or phone, leading to a perception of neglect and frustration.
themes.business_impact: The lack of timely support erodes user trust, increases churn risk among high-value customers, and damages brand reputation, ultimately reducing lifetime value and hindering growth initiatives.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Support staff are either understaffed or not properly integrated with communication channels, causing delays and missed escalations; existing ticketing and notification workflows are likely inadequate or misconfigured.
themes.action_plan:
• Implement a unified ticketing system with automated acknowledgment
• Hire and train dedicated support agents for high-touch response
• Establish clear SLA for first response within 4 hours and resolution within 48 hours
• Set up monitoring dashboards for response times and CSAT scores
• Conduct quarterly reviews and continuous improvement cycles
